title: A folder chosen in the system's chooser
description: `{ path, name, found, boards? }`, the folder the person picked in the system's own folder chooser, as list_folders heads its listing; or `{ cancelled: true }` when the person closed the chooser without picking one.

path.description: The picked folder's real path. open_project opens it, wherever it is, for the rest of this server's run.

found.description: True when this folder has a Vision Board: open it with open_project; else create one there with `create: true`.

boards.description: How many boards its ledgers hold; given only when `found` is true.

cancelled.description: The person closed the chooser without picking a folder; nothing changed.
